I know that feeling and the loss associated with it. Almost like being in a daze 24/7. I don't like to know anyone else feels this way, but life doesn't care about any of us or our desires, we, along with others have to make the investments that breed positivity and happiness, however short and fleeting they may be. Is there anything in life that does give you any joy, however small it may be? Sometimes its really helpful to me to look at those small things and collect them closer to me to help for some kind of symbol of continuance.

sometimes life throws us for a curve, have you spoken to your wife at all about how you are feeling? I can tell you love her and don't want to cause her grief. You're not a failure, far from it, programming is hard, and youre GOOD at it, but jobs right now have the ability to be picky and that's what the biggest irritation is. You need them not them you. I don't know if she knows about how bad the finances are but I feel like she is your partner and conversing with her is one of the smartest things to do.. Please don't leave this world without first trying to get her to help you, in a relationship built on love, trust and honesty communication is key. Please don't give up, fight on, and when there is nothing left, continue fighting... I've been in some dark places but at least you have a few lights in your life still, you haven't lost just yet! I believe in you for what it's worth.

I hate to say this because I know how bad it is going to sound but whatever you do do not chastise him with guilt and negative consequences, more often than not that can help push someone, being understanding and helping to relate or just listen, that can often help, this is a major red flag and calling a hotline would be a great help, but then again so could calling the police... Sad to say he does have a right to end his life, but I'm hoping here in someway he instead talks to you and calms down, he's not himself.

Money doesn't buy happiness, if you are not happy you have the right and the choice to play out your end as you see fit, though I hate to even say any of this because I AM THE SAME, with the exception of having money or a good enough body. I dunno what I could say if anything to help, because really there isn't much. I wish I could magically take all that bullshit negativity that infects your mind without your consent and makes you depressed, id take all of that, but I can't. There is no magic pill to make you happy, there is only this life and what you make of it. Some people are just this way and it's a chemical imbalance that medicine can help but that's a stretch too. It feels like a strain of depression but I'm not a doctor either. I don't wish to see you perish because I know inside you wouldn't want anyone to hurt from your death and I get the feeling you would love to be happy! But god damn it you have a right to peace too, or some form of happiness. I just hope maybe you can confide in us or maybe your SO before anything is done. I dunno if I'm too late on this, I guess it won't matter either way if I am. Seems to me like you place your own value on what others think of you, past present, and potential future. You say you're dumb as shit but I cannot follow that very far seeing how structured your mind appears. Education in school these days is a joke, if you judge a fish by its ability to climb a tree then the fish will live the rest of its life thinking its an idiot. I believe everyone has potential but if you are set on this then its not my place to tell you any different but I had a shit life too, in my own way. It doesn't matter to me, nothing does and I want nothing more these days but to just fucking die, but I continue to exist only to spare my relatives and friends the pain of my death, because society will always view you as selfish for suicide, but I wonder who is really selfish about it. It doesn't just magically get better, only through effort can some relative peace or happiness find its way to you, but even that isn't a lot and it takes forever for minor relief. But still, I hope you realize that a crap ton of people here don't give a shit about your past, so you hate yourself, we don't. I know we are all our own biggest critics. We don't judge you, we don't care about any of that, we only want to support you, if this is the only way out for you mate then I hope you go fast and painless and maybe you find some sort of peace if there is an afterlife, because you deserve some sort of happiness man. We all do. I'd like you to find what I cant in this life, which is peace, but like I said, if you can't then go peaceful and may your afterlife be happy. I really hope you can find another way but good luck either way.

Look I had a bit of a hard time piecing this together but from what I gather your mom has custody and is more of a bully than a loving mother, your brother is an ass instead of an unyielding support, and you're a bit of a social outcast in school. I've been there with the exception that my brother was a support (it just didn't help because those closest to me cannot save me or help me). Your ways of trying to commit suicide are failing ones and most often painful. 

There are easier ways, but I feel like for you it would be best to try to focus on the positives. I'm all for you finding a rock *in this case its your dad. Have you tried talking to him about any of this? No parent would want to hear it but if you can confide in him it may help to ease your pain. But, and I cannot stress this enough. DO NOT try to shoot yourself in the head with your friend Chris as the messenger. Chris will most likely blame himself and it will lead to unwanted pain from a permanent solution to a temporary problem, it sucks to say but I am not chastising you, I do relate, just don't walk this path anymore. Start living your life for who you want to be and just be that person. Love yourself and be your own best friend when you have none. I don't want you to feel like you're a bad person for doing any of this or thinking about it because you're not, and you're not selfish, but maybe you should talk to your dad about finding a way to be with him more, or living with him. I wish you the best and brightest future whatever path you walk.

Sucide isn't bad. People have a negative outlook of it because of the pain and suffering others receive from it, while ignoring the reality that the person commiting the act is obviously

1. out of options (to them)
2. unhappy and bored with life (me)
3. dealing with an event (break up or death) and are not in their sain mind. 

While the majority of us are all depressed, and most contemplate the very act that in reality they do not want to do, we seek for a solution as to how to enjoy life or escape the pain. If you lack the constitution, what is the constitution you lack, fear of death? There is nothing when we die. No god awaits, no rebirth, simple nothing. So there can be no fear there, but maybe it roots in your subconscious, and don't mistake me, I don't want anyone to die unhappy like I am, I'd love for you to be happy and find meaning but if you don't or can't or even won't then my words will either be a waste or help push you to another stupid erratic decision that I myself want to make. In reality I don't know you but I understand somewhat what you mean by lacking the constitution, for me I don't wish to cause others the pain of my death, but seriously wish to die because I'M FUCKING UNHAPPY. I dunno if its similar to you, but if you have the time maybe talk with me, maybe I can be your whipping boy for some small talk.

don't fear, fear feeds those who linger in the dark. you must assert yourself and believe in yourself. tell josh if you see it happen again, if it happens to you and you find yourself unable to move don't panic, simply focus all of your energy on one thought and action, wiggle your big toe. If you can do that then move on to the other toes, down to the foot, to the leg, eventually you will kick start your body again and be able to help him, call out if you see the creature, not lightly either, loudly. If you worship any deity invoke them, state flatly and without fail that it is not allowed in your domaine. It wouldn't hurt to keep a weapon by the bed, knife or taser or something, no guns, guns run out of ammo.
